subject.title: feat(ui): make the sidebar agent chip body the menu trigger

question: After resume parity is restored, should the sidebar chip body permanently change from a direct latest-conversation shortcut to a menu-first trigger?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes a primary Control UI interaction and removes the previous direct-click semantics, so final acceptance of that menu-first UX belongs to the UI owner even though the single-agent regression is mechanically fixable.

options.title: Adopt menu-first with parity
options.body: Keep the large menu trigger, add a current-agent resume row for single-agent setups, and require browser proof before merge.

options.title: Retain direct resume
options.body: Keep the chip body as the latest-conversation shortcut and improve the separate menu trigger's discoverability and hit area instead.

options.title: Pause the interaction change
options.body: Close or defer the PR until a broader sidebar navigation design establishes the intended primary action.

recommendation.title: Adopt menu-first with parity
recommendation.body: Keep the large menu trigger, add a current-agent resume row for single-agent setups, and require browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior merged Control UI refactor history and current ownership of this interaction make this the strongest available product-routing candidate.
